subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: What public opt-out contract should OpenClaw expose for built-in skill source scanning?
rationale: The fix adds public `skills.load` config surface and changes built-in skill-source behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product/API direction.

options.title: Approve source-level opt-out
options.body: Add a typed source-disable contract that covers loader discovery, watcher targets, status/docs, and tests while preserving current defaults when unset.

options.title: Narrow to personal-source toggle
options.body: Expose only a personal agent skills toggle if maintainers want to avoid a broader source-policy API for now.

options.title: Reject new config
options.body: Keep current built-in scanning behavior and document per-skill disables or prompt limits as the supported workaround.

recommendation.title: Approve source-level opt-out
recommendation.body: Add a typed source-disable contract that covers loader discovery, watcher targets, status/docs, and tests while preserving current defaults when unset.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent area ownership point to this person for the current skills loader/watcher surface and config-policy-sensitive follow-up.
